title: Plathong
description: A LINE chatbot for home blood-pressure tracking: send a photo of the monitor and AI reads it, charts the trend and reminds you of appointments.

title: Leptospirosis animation
description: A 60-second animated explainer on leptospirosis and flood water.

title: Dog-Bite-Me
description: Offline-first rabies guide in Thai, English and Burmese: triage a bite in about 5 taps, wash and go-now steps, and a printable vaccine dose card.

title: Episignal
description: Open global outbreak intelligence: reported infectious-disease events on a map, each one linked to its source.

title: MantaSlide
description: Control PowerPoint from your phone over Wi-Fi: presenter notes, next-slide preview and a laser pointer. No app or account.

title: School norovirus outbreak, Amnat Charoen
fullTitle: A Food Poisoning Outbreak in a School from Progressive Contamination of Norovirus, Amnat Charoen Province, Thailand, February 2025
description: 142 of 470 people fell ill (30.2%). A chicken rice meal was the likely source, and later serving groups had higher risk, pointing to progressive contamination.

title: Two rabies deaths, Prathai district
fullTitle: Spatial and epidemiologic analysis of two human rabies fatalities reveals transmission drivers and prevention gaps in Prathai district Thailand 2025
description: Both deaths followed unvaccinated dog bites. Full five-dose PEP completion was under 1%, and true dog vaccination coverage was about 40%.

title: Scarlet fever outbreak, Samut Prakan school
fullTitle: Investigation of a Scarlet Fever Outbreak in a Primary School, Samut Prakan Province, Thailand, January – March 2025
description: 93 cases (5.1% attack rate), spread person to person, helped by crowded classrooms and poor ventilation. Control measures stopped transmission.
